newsitem.title: USA: U.S. power output rises 1.1 pct vs. year ago - EEI.
newsitem.headline: U.S. power output rises 1.1 pct vs. year ago - EEI.

text.p: Electricity deliveries in the continental U.S. totaled 61,225 gigawatt hours (GWh) for the week ended March 1, up 1.1 percent from the same period in 1996, the Edison Electric Institute (EEI) said Wednesday.
The amount of weekly power supplied to the South Central area showed the largest year-to-year rise, up 4.5 percent to 7,884 GWh, EEI said.
The Pacific Northwest region experienced the sharply decline in power output, tumbling 10.2 percent from the corresponding period a year earlier to 3,454 GWh.
Year-to-date domestic power production for the first nine weeks of 1997 totaled 578,983 GWh, a rise of 0.3 percent from the same period in 1996, EEI said.
